findings.description: AC-5 table row (line 282) still reads '<= 1e-3 relative above r=100' with no antipode carve-out; the absolute bound (<= 1e-8 rad where delta < 1e-5; 102 of 10k probes, measured 1.2e-9) exists only in the dated As-built note and the test. Justified (relative error is meaningless as delta -> 0, and 1e-8 rad is far tighter than the 1.2e-4 budget), but the contract row was not amended.
findings.suggestion: Edit the AC-5 row (dated) to state the split bound so the contract and the test agree.

findings.description: Round trip: sprint criterion says '1000 pairs within 2e-4 rad'. The source-plane bound is asserted only for the 1531 images with dpsi/dF >= 1e-3 (worst 8.5e-5); 469 deep-edge images (demagnified > 1000x) are checked in the image plane only (worst 1.9e-5). The reasoning (dF/dpsi amplifies 1e-10 rad image error) is sound and the image-plane check holds for all 2000, so the AC is not hollowed, but the shader golden (M3.4) must not assume source-plane 2e-4 at the edge.
findings.suggestion: Amend the sprint/design criterion wording to the split; note in M3.4 that the edge images are image-plane accurate.

findings.description: The FS writer runs under --bytecode without --strict-bytecode (std/fs evaluator-only on strict VM). Honest and mitigated: the generator lens_lut.ail is pure and strict-checked, lens-lut-check compares row 128 strict VM = interpreter = bin bytes, and the sampled regeneration is bit-identical. Upstream DX report claimed in notes but not verified by me.
findings.suggestion: Cite the upstream issue number at the site and in CLAUDE.md workaround list once filed.

findings.description: h = 0.0025 instead of 0.005 is justified: measured 1.3e-4 rad at shadow edge with h=0.005 exceeds the 1.2e-4 AC-5 budget; 8e-6 at 0.0025. Cost doubled (436 s wall on 14 jobs, ~40 CPU-min), within the plan's 60-min threshold. Not a weakening; it tightens against the design's V10 estimate. Design text elsewhere still mentions 0.005 in the plan lines (only the As-built note corrects it).
findings.suggestion: Optionally edit the plan line to h=0.0025 with a dated marker.
